actions.text: Proving Grounds, level 1. Walk east to the exit. The armory needs the keycard from the north-west room.

events.name: Hall door opens as you approach

actions.text: Keycard acquired. The armory door is unlocked.

events.name: Push wall to the hidden cache

actions.text: Pump Station. Mind the pit and the acid. Turn the two valves to drain the pool.
Pool drained. Stairs are rising in the lower hall.
The station shudders. Take the lift by the exit.
Careful: the pit has no bottom.
Command Core. Clear the core floor to open the vault.
Core floor clear. The vault is open.

else_actions.text: The vault exit is at the far east wall.

then_actions.text: The vault key opens the way out.

meta.author: Retro FPS GCS
meta.description: The sample campaign: three short levels that show doors and keys, secrets, lifts, hazards, scripted events and every enemy type.
meta.title: Proving Grounds
